# Version 2 (Without Solutions)(1)

> **Self-contained visual Markdown conversion.** Each original PDF page
> is embedded directly inside this `.md` file, so the questions,
> fractions, exponents, radicals, graphs, handwriting, and worked
> solutions remain human-readable without separate image files.

> The embedded page image is the visual authority. A searchable text
> layer follows each page; PDF extraction can distort mathematical
> notation, so use the image whenever the two differ.
